title: Ego cannot deliver the peace it promises
summary: Ego cannot make peace; Naam cools what self-will inflames. Take Naam before self-will turns unrest into policy.
takeaway: Take Naam before self-will turns unrest into policy.
lifeApplication: When self-will starts explaining itself, pause for Naam before you let the mind make another false rule.

source.shortMeaning: Ego cannot make peace; Naam cools what self-will inflames.
source.lifeApplication: When self-will rises, take Naam before trying to win the moment.
